# Progression
WH14K has two progression layers: [color=#a4885c]team[/color] — within a single round, and [color=#a4885c]meta-progress[/color] — on your account, between rounds.
## Team progression (within a round) The team earns front points for kills and holding [textlink="influence points" link="WH40KInfluence"], and spends them on [textlink="reinforcements" link="WH40KCommand"] and the [textlink="upgrade tree" link="WH40KCommand"].
- The team starts with a small point reserve and the first level. - With each point threshold reached the team levels up — there are several, and each strengthens the faction. - A kill earns points: a little for a regular fighter, double for a special role, triple for an enemy officer or squad leader.
## Tech levels As the team level rises, machine and logistics tiers unlock. The higher the tier, the faster structures work and the more cargo flows through: - [color=#a4885c]Machines[/color] process materials noticeably faster at high tiers. - [color=#a4885c]Logistics[/color] pushes more cargo per run and cuts delivery time. - [color=#a4885c]Ore extractor[/color] yields ore more often and in bigger batches — pump the team level and mining flies.
## Meta-progress (on the account) Saved forever. Experience accrues from everything you do in rounds — kills, healing allies, deliveries, point captures, just participating.
- There are many levels, and each one raises the experience requirement. - For each new level you receive decorations and character development points. - [color=#a4885c]Achievements[/color] — separate goals with experience and rewards. Some are per-round (a kill streak, allies saved), some are over your career (dozens of wins, hundreds of rounds). - [color=#a4885c]Decorations[/color] — OOC titles, your name's colors and ghost skins. Some unlock only through achievements or via the Discord server. - [color=#a4885c]Character development[/color] — organ branches where development points are spent.
## Example achievements - [color=#a4885c]Fireline Initiation[/color] — a kill streak in a single round, grants the "Legend" title. - [color=#a4885c]No One Left Behind[/color] — save several allies in one round. - [color=#a4885c]Convoy Master[/color] — complete deliveries in a round. - [color=#a4885c]Veteran of Wars[/color] — finish many rounds over your career. - [color=#a4885c]Victory Parade[/color] — win many games over your career, grants the "Saint" title.
## Character development (organs) Six development branches, one per organ: brain, lungs, kidneys, heart, liver, stomach. Each branch starts at a root and forks into two paths — upper and lower. To open the far nodes you need to go through the previous ones. Spend development points thoughtfully — ask yourself what playstyle you want to strengthen.
